name: vendorName
description: Who was paid, as recorded on the vendor

name: settlement
description: Ready to use as a heading: "Paid in full" or "Part payment"

name: amountPaid
description: What went out in this payment, with its currency

name: paidOn
description: The date the money left, ISO

name: method
description: How it was sent: bank transfer, cash, mobile money

name: reference
description: OUR transfer reference, so they can find it on their statement

name: paidFrom
description: The account it was sent from, by name only — never an account number

name: billCode
description: Our own reference for the bill, e.g. EXP-000002

name: billTitle
description: What the bill is for, as recorded

name: billDescription
description: The longer description, where one was written

name: vendorReference
description: THEIR invoice or reservation number, where we recorded it. The thing they will search by

name: billTotal
description: The whole bill, with its currency

name: balanceRemaining
description: What is still owed after this payment, with its currency. Zero when settled

name: isSettled
description: "yes" when nothing is left owing, "no" when this is a part payment

name: safariName
description: The trip the bill belongs to, if any

name: safariCode
description: That trip's code, which suppliers often quote back

name: notes
description: Anything the office added to the payment
